name: qkd_cdc_wleaf_ref-q13a-COMMIT
purpose: q13-cdcw: hardened slot-shaped view for the Qwen3-8B ROM TP8 die cell qkd_cdc_wleaf (KV write-side CDC leaf, 128 instances; contract v3 slot cdc_EN_0). RTL = ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc MARGIN 1 / LCRED 6 / SYNC 2 / RSEL 1 / RNG 10 (the closed qfd_cdc_eco_h1 structure: TT +46.9 / FF +1.2 / DRC 0, no structural timing defect) under the cell-name wrapper qkd_cdc_wleaf; reference tile flow, 183.6 x 183.6, M5 cap (PG M5, strap M6, pins M4 W/E, M5 N/S), faces per the slot (co W, hi + clk N, ho E, wi/wr/cf S, hclk + resets W); two clock roots core clk 833.333 ps + hclk 1,024 ps with the old kit's crossing constraints (max-delay datapath budget both ways, no clock groups, no false paths) and per-domain boundary 0.2 T; inhold + outhold deterministic IO hold stages; TT/FF/SS view export

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_cdc_wleaf u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/kv/qkd_cdc_wleaf.sv rtl/hdc/kv/ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_kreg.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: qkd_cdc_wleaf_equiv
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/cw_0 -P tb_qkd_cdc_wleaf_equiv.NEG=0 rtl/test/qwen_blocks/tb_qkd_cdc_wleaf_equiv.sv rtl/hdc/kv/qkd_cdc_wleaf.sv rtl/hdc/kv/ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_kreg.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/cw_0

bench.name: qkd_cdc_wleaf_neg
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/cw_1 -P tb_qkd_cdc_wleaf_equiv.NEG=1 rtl/test/qwen_blocks/tb_qkd_cdc_wleaf_equiv.sv rtl/hdc/kv/qkd_cdc_wleaf.sv rtl/hdc/kv/ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_kreg.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/cw_1

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_cdc_wleaf_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_cdc_wleaf_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_cdc_wleaf_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_cdc_wleaf  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
